summary.description: One concise sentence describing the whole image.

genre_or_photography_type.description: Ordered from primary to secondary photographic genre/type.

species.description: Always present. Biological/taxonomy candidates when a genre entry is wildlife, bird_photography, or plant_botanical; otherwise an empty array. Prefer species-level names when visibly supported; broader taxa are allowed when narrower identification is uncertain.

main_subjects.description: Primary visible subjects in the full frame.

scene_context.description: Whole-frame context such as street scene, portrait setup, performance, or outdoor wildlife scene.

habitat_or_setting.description: Visible habitat, setting, or environment. Do not infer geographic location.

behavior_or_action.description: Visible behavior, pose, action, or activity.

proposed_keywords.description: Metadata-oriented terms for later normalization. Exclude exact duplicate species/taxonomy terms, camera/lens/software terms, and file-processing terms.

uncertainty_notes.description: Brief notes about uncertainty, partial visibility, or ambiguous identification.

quality_assessment.description: Whole-image perceptual quality assessment. Keep separate from tags and proposed keywords.

focus.description: Whether the intended subject or important detail is appropriately sharp. Do not penalize effective intentional motion blur.

composition.description: Framing, balance, visual hierarchy, edge control, and distracting mergers.

exposure_and_tone.description: Whether important highlights, shadows, and midtones are suitably rendered.

lighting_and_color.description: Effectiveness and coherence of light direction, contrast, white balance, and color.

subject_background_relationship.description: Subject separation, depth-of-field use, background contribution, and distractions. Use unrated when no distinct subject exists.

moment_or_expression.description: Effectiveness of visible gesture, expression, behavior, or timing. Use unrated when not relevant.

technical_cleanliness.description: Obvious visible noise, halos, banding, compression, oversmoothing, masking, or other processing artifacts.

overall_effectiveness.description: Overall photographic effectiveness relative to the visible subject, genre, and apparent intent; do not calculate an average.

strengths.description: Up to two concise visible strengths. Use an empty array when none are clear.

concerns.description: Up to two concise visible weaknesses. Use an empty array when none are clear.

confidence.description: Confidence in the quality assessment as a whole.
Ordinal confidence band. Numeric confidence is intentionally not used.

genre_term.description: Controlled vocabulary for photographic genre or photography type.

evidence.description: Short visible-evidence phrase, not a reasoning trace.

quality_level.description: Use problem for a visible weakness, acceptable for adequate execution, strong when the criterion materially supports the photograph, and unrated when the criterion is not relevant or cannot be judged reliably.

quality_note.description: One concise visible observation, not a reasoning trace or edit instruction.
